movie.title: Kill Me Again
movie.overview: Charlie, a notorious serial killer known as the Midnight Mangler finds himself trapped, reliving the same violent night over and over. Initially embracing his grisly urges, Charlie soon becomes desperate to escape the endless nightmare.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
Of course this is murder-Groundhog day
The twist is nice, very reminiscent of old Twilight Zone, but before you get there you get Groundhog day, but with a serial killer.

The setup is enticing, the execution fun while flawed, but it makes it across the finish-line and it is a fun movie.

Also great fun to see Master Ken in a movie like this. He, like the rest of the cast, do their jobs well and you feel immersed in this oddball idea.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A notorious serial killer finds himself trapped in a temporal loop, forced to relive the same violent night until his sadistic desires turn into a desperate fight for escape.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Charlie, a ruthless murderer known as the Midnight Mangler, becomes trapped in a harrowing time loop that resets every night. At first, he sees the repetition as an opportunity to indulge his darkest impulses without consequence. However, as the cycle repeats endlessly, the psychological toll deepens, forcing him to confront the overwhelming horror of his own inescapable reality. Desperate to break free, Charlie must unravel the dark mystery behind his eternal nightmare.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Charlie is a brutal serial killer who has terrorized the region under the moniker of the Midnight Mangler. His horrifying spree comes to an abrupt halt when he suddenly becomes trapped in a time loop, doomed to wake up and repeat the exact same terrifying night. During the initial iterations, Charlie revels in the situation, using the endless resetting of time to commit heinous acts with complete impunity. However, as the continuous repetition stretches on, the excitement quickly fades into psychological torment and intense isolation. Every victim, every strike, and every moment of violence begins to echo back onto him, blurring the lines between predator and prey. As panic sets in, Charlie tries changing his actions to break the cycle, only to realize the nightmare is tightening its grip. He begins searching frantically for the root cause of the anomaly, suspecting it may be a form of supernatural retribution or a mental prison of his own making. The violent night becomes a grueling arena of survival where his own murderous tendencies become his ultimate enemy. To end the torment, Charlie is forced to confront the full, horrifying weight of his actions in a desperate attempt to find a way out.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Kill Me Again is a dark, psychological thriller that blends horror with a high-concept temporal twist. The story follows Charlie, a infamous serial killer known as the Midnight Mangler, who discovers he is inexplicably trapped in a time loop, reliving a single violent night repeatedly. The film explores the terrifying breakdown of a sadistic mind when faced with infinite repetition, transforming a killer's dream into an inescapable personal hell. Driven by suspense and dramatic intensity, the narrative follows Charlie's journey from monstrous indulgence to harrowing desperation as he seeks to break the endless cycle.
